normalized_text:
Position: Sales Executive
Location: Kochi, Kerala
Department: Sales

Job Summary
We are seeking a driven Sales Executive to grow our retail distributor network in the FMCG sector.

REQUIREMENTS
- At least 2 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably FMCG
- Strong negotiation and relationship-building skills
- Experience using CRM tools (Zoho, Salesforce, or similar)
- Bachelor's degree in any discipline; BBA preferred

RESPONSIBILITIES
- Onboard new retail partners
- Manage and grow existing distributor accounts
- Meet monthly and quarterly sales targets
- Travel within the assigned territory as needed
